title: Prove Permutation Invariance with Symmetric Pooling
summary: Pool valid point features channel by channel and demonstrate that point order cannot change the result.

runtime.budget_status: actual shared worker caps; per-process address-space limit

physical_contract.axes: B cloud batch, N unordered point slots, D feature channels; reduce only N.
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: No timestamp input; any temporal or scene alignment is an upstream caller responsibility.
physical_contract.batching: B,N,D positive. A boolean B-by-N mask marks valid point slots; every cloud has at least one valid point.

public_case_families: permutation with channel maxima at different points
negative valid features with high padding
hidden_case_families: all-invalid cloud and empty dimensions rejected
permutations applied jointly to mask and features
